Hệ thống loa thông báo

Aircraft Public Address (PA) system, used by flight and cabin crew for delivering announcements, emergency messages, and safety information to passengers.

Definition

Aircraft Public Address (PA) system, used by flight and cabin crew for delivering announcements, emergency messages, and safety information to passengers.

Operational example

Cabin crew, please test the PA system before boarding to ensure announcements are clear throughout the aircraft.
